I’ve been bringing my pets to Ingleside Animal Hospital for over a decade, but my recent experience — especially with manager Kimberly — has completely destroyed my trust in this place.

My cat is dying from kidney disease and also has thyroid issues. He needs lifelong medication to stay stable. I called to get his refills like I always do, and suddenly I was told I needed an appointment first. Fine — but then they demanded an $83.50 deposit, something I’ve never been asked for in 10+ years of going here.

What makes this worse is that they charged me $83.50 for a missed appointment even though I called to reschedule because of an emergency. Last appointment I missed was in May of 2023. I called as soon as I could. Instead of understanding, Kimberly was cold, smug, and completely uncaring. She told me she was keeping the $83.50 and that I’d have to pay another deposit to get my cat’s life‑saving medication.

Meanwhile, they charge nearly $380 every few months for kidney bloodwork — and never once required a deposit for those appointments. But suddenly, when my cat is at his sickest, they decide to squeeze every dollar they can.

They are literally holding my cat’s medication hostage unless I pay them again. After 10 years of loyalty, this is how they treat someone with a dying pet.

This is not compassionate care. This is a predatory, money‑draining practice that puts profit over the well‑being of animals. No pet owner should be treated this way, especially in an emergency situation.

I’ve been bringing my pets to Ingleside Animal Hospital since 2016, and I never thought I would be treated the way I was treated recently. I was dealing with a very sick pet, and as anyone who has ever cared for an animal knows, emergencies don’t always go as planned. Despite knowing my situation, the manager, Kimberly, chose to keep my $83 deposit simply because I was late to the appointment.

That $83 was meant for my cat’s treatment — not to pad anyone’s pockets. Instead of showing understanding or compassion, I was told the money would not be returned. After years of loyalty, this was extremely disappointing.

What hurts the most is the complete lack of empathy. When families are dealing with sick animals, the last thing they need is to be punished financially for circumstances outside their control. A veterinary clinic should care about animals and the people who love them. This experience made me feel like neither mattered here.

I’m speaking up not just for myself, but for every pet owner who has ever struggled with emergencies, delays, or unexpected situations. Policies should never come before compassion — especially in a place that claims to care for animals.

I hope Ingleside reconsiders how they treat long‑time clients and the families who trust them with their pets’ lives.s

— Angela Rose

I wish I could give 10 stars! The team here at Ingleside is so professional and friendly. They give the best advice and the best care. I can get an appointment pretty easily without a long wait time. The costs here at Ingleside are generally more affordable compared to other vets in the Scottsdale area. Every time I have questions or concerns, they make me feel better. My dogs definitely appreciate all of your help! Thank you for everything!!

Always friend and on point.  I love this place and trust these people faithfully.  The staff is so considerate of financial situations and courtesy to owner/pet. I appreciate the neutering they did on my boy. He does not look bad versus if we went to the Humane Society.

My visit in January seemed to go well. I explained I was concerned that my cat was hyperthyroid and exhibited all the classic symptoms. They took my cat and did the exam in a back room as well as $600 worth of bloodwork. They said they would call with the results. When they called, they said all the results were normal. I explained he was very thin but the vet said his weight was perfect. A week ago my cat went blind. He has hypertension most likely from hyperthyroidism. Turns out a senior cat can have normal labs, “sick euthyroid”. No one checked his blood pressure or looked at his retinas. Thankfully a vet in Flagstaff did. Fingers crossed he gets some vision back. But I won’t be returning to Ingleside.
Nice place with boarding & grooming available. They do care about animals. I will suggest pet insurance or CareCredit.

this vet clinic is no good.   Very poor customer service and even worse animal care.   I will never come back here and strongly recommend you save your time and money and avoid this place.
My dog got sick early Sunday morning. They were able to get us in, even as a new patient. Dr. Brown & team are wonderful! Very thorough and I am grateful for them.

Horrible experience with this veterinary clinic. My dog was prescribed fluoxetine by Dr Hebah Mohamed since 07/24/23. My pharmacy called the office to ask for a new prescription for my dog and the office denied the request. Instead of the office contacting me in to inform me that a wellness exam was needed they instead chose to do nothing instead. When I contacted the office to request a dose for my dog because he was completely out of his medication and hard stopping the medication is not okay, they denied the request, despite agreeing that the medication should not be stopped abruptly, because he was past due on him wellness exam. It’s unethical that this  money hungry veterinary office was unwilling to fill just an extra day’s worth of medication to avoid having my dog go without his medication for the night while I figure out my schedule to bring my dog to the office. It was either I bring him in tomorrow morning or be told “I’m not sure what you want me to do”. I won’t be back to a vet office that thinks to ethically okay to discontinue a medication cold turkey when it requires a person or a pet to be weaned off of it.

He was very friendly and intentional handling Jasper which means a lot to us. There is a lot of pressure to make the right choice when selecting a primary vet office and Dominic made us feel confident we were making the right choice!

We're on a road trip and wanted a 2nd opinion to ease our concerns of our senior dog as we continue on our travels. Friendly staff, Dr Ellen answered all my questions and gave my family peace of mind. I felt that our dog was well taken care!

I have 2 dogs and a cat that all go here for anything they need - I wouldn't take my pets anywhere else!!
The Ingleside team is great! I know that my dog is getting top-notch care during his visits.

Special shout out to Brandon who was so kind to help me administer Marley’s medications after his surgery when I was having a lot of trouble. I was really emotional and stressed and everyone at Ingleside was really kind and patient!

Awesome experience.

Can’t recommend enough!

I have been bringing my pup Jordy here for a couple of years now. Every time I call, staff always answer the phone immediately. I always get reminders when my dog is due for vaccines/ check ups which I find helpful. I am always able to get an appointment quickly within a few days, and every Doc we have seen here has been wonderful. We've seen Drs Brown, Gesina, Mohamed and some of the others and they have all been great. They always give us the necessary medications on the spot and can give you information about cost right up front and work with me on getting information to my insurance. 10/10 recommend and will continue to come here even though we moved further away. They always call to check up and follow through on communication.

Also, my pup is very very anxious and does NOT like the vet but they have worked with me to figure out a routine and make him comfortable and it has made it a much better experience for him, me, and the staff. I don't dread bringing him anymore which is huge.

I've got the Ingleside for a number of years and I've never been disappointed in any visit. Everything is clearly explained upfront, and the veterinarians are compassionate and gentle. I really prefer to see Dr. Serbin but every vet has been excellent. My dog Mookie is a very frightened dog even at home and she is treated with such kindness and compassion that I see her coming a little bit out of her shell. My dog Vinny plays off Mookie's emotions and badly misbehaved at the last appointment, including urinating and defecating on the floor, and everyone was very kind and he ended up leaving very cheerfully, and I have no doubt that he will be a happy dog treated at this office for years to come.  I am going to have dental work done for Mookie here in the near future, and she recently started on some allergy tablets, which are already working excellently for her. I could not be more pleased, and I am very satisfied with the explanations, the callbacks with the lab results that have been quite prompt and faster than I do as a physician, And the stellar service I have always received here.

After visiting Ingleside, I'm transferring my dog's care there from a neighborhood vet.  His other vet was fine, but hours were limited and the team was rushed.  Ingleside is equipped and staffed very well, my dog's care has been thorough, compassionate and allows me to call or take him in conveniently (around my work schedule).

We have begun using Ingleside as our pet care facility. We really appreciate the staff. The customer service team is exceptional, always available and helpful. The doctors are knowledgeable of my English Bulldog. It’s great to be with doctors that know how to handle special breed dogs. They are responsive to questions and offer advice.

Thank You
Staff is always very friendly in person and over the phone. They always call to check up after appointments and I feel truly care about their patients.

Yeah, they care About your animals lol

Our veterinarian is wonderful. She is thorough, listens to your concerns, and she does not try to upsell you on unnecessary services of products. The vet techs and other back of office staff are exceptionally caring as well. We know our pets are always in good hands when they need care. The services seem pricy but it’s likely due to the location.

My only concerns are a few instances of variable communication and lack of detail with the front office staff. We pick up a monthly paper script and every time I have to triple check that it’s printed, the DEA number is written at the top, and that it’s ready for pickup. There’s been times that they filled it instead of providing a paper copy, or I’ve driven across town to our pharmacy and couldn’t fill it without a written DEA number, or I’ve called and been told the script was ready and when I showed up it was not. Another recent issue was being quoted $1200 (estimate) for a dental by our vet, then when I showed up to pay, the front office staff said it was about $1,000, then one minute later she printed the invoice only for it to say almost $1,400 was due. Why did the price increase by $400 in a matter of seconds? When I politely asked for an explanation, there wasn’t one. It would really help me as a customer if the front office staff were more detailed and more accurate about the information they provide.

All trust lost to this place. We will no longer be bringing our 3 cats to this office. They "stand by their technicians care". The nurse who took the temperature penetrated my cats pee hole rather than the butt. They didnt care to make sure she was OK after I sent a photo of some blood coming out of her pee hole. We didnt realize this until 230pm her appointment was at 1230. We ran some errands before getting home and during her feeding, I pet her back and noticed her pee hole looked irritated. Then it made sense to me why my cat was crying the way she did when the temperature was taken. We live 25 min away. The doctor sounded so cold and heartless when we told her what had happened and didnt care to check her since it was very close to 3. I regret not asking for Dr Muhammad since she is the main care giver. We miss Dr schacca. We understand mistakes can happen but for the doctor to act like it was our fault was absolutely un called for. Please train your nurses better and to be careful. We wont bring our cats back because of this traumatic experience.

We are so glad we found Ingleside. They are helping us manage a case of valley fever for one of our dogs. I highly recommend Dr Molly. She has a practical approach to identifying the concerns and creating a plan to address it. They follow up when they say they will and are easy to communicate with. We also met Dr. G for a wellness check for our second dog. She was also great and very easy to talk with. Prices for blood work and vaccines are reasonable. We are so happy that we found a partner to help us manage our dogs care. Highly recommended

Update: valley Fever tither prices have significantly increased at a rate I feel is unreasonable.

Update: they reached out and opened discussion about how we can balance being cost effective and do what is right for overall health which I really appreciate.
Friendly caring staff. The doctor was patient with me and explained everything in detail.

Google says your open til 7 , I called at 5:30 and you were closed.  Please correct this.  Thanks

Our menagerie has always been treated well by the super friendly and expert staff at Ingleside.  We have mostly seen Doctors Serbin and Ainsworth, who has recently moved on to open his own practice.   We have  on occasion seen Bart and Rolando and found them to be excellent as well.  You can tell that every single person at any level in Ingleside is there because they truly love animals.  I have been to vets who were actually afraid of our dogs, but everyone from office personnel to chief vet at Ingleside actually gets down on the floor and romps with our 140 lb Rotti.  We have had the poor fortune to have had five dogs with massive medical issues over the past few years, and Dr. Serbin and his crew have always been quick to assess the gravity of the situation and explain the options.  When appropriate they immediately called a specialist and pushed us out the door instead of trying to keep the work in house.  Consequently, our two year old Rotti is happy and healthy after brain surgery at seven weeks.  For the cases where there was no miracle available, Ingleside provided the most sensitive and palatable euthanasia experience imaginable.  Unfortunately, love alone will not keep the doors open, so they do charge fees commensurate with the services performed.  I don't comparison shop my pet's welfare and fervently hope that Ingleside stays in business forever to care for my brood!
